{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Stalhorse: Pictured!.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Juannelle]] |location= Snowfield Stable |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Silver Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Stalhorse: Pictured!||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Stalhorse: Pictured!}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Snowfield Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At the [[Snowfield Stable]], [[Link]] can encounter [[Juannelle]] wondering what she will do.{{Cite|Hmmm...what'll I do...|Juannelle|BotW}} She explains that she has been traveling all over [[Hyrule Kingdom|Hyrule]] in search of information.{{Cite|I've traveled to the east and west in my great hunt for information, and now I find myself here in the freezing north...|Juannelle|BotW}} She wants to see a [[Stalhorse]], but the [[Freezing Climate]] of the [[Tabantha Tundra]] has stalled her progress.{{Cite|I heard there was a {{Color BotW|Red|Stalhorse}} in this area, but I can't take it any longer! It's too cold to look anymore!|Juannelle|BotW}} When Link inquires further, Juannelle believes that he is also interested in the Stalhorse.{{Cite|[A Stalhorse?] {{Big|Beep-beep!}} You just set off Juannelle's intuition sensors! You're interested in the {{Color BotW|Red|Stalhorse}} too, huh?|Juannelle|BotW}} She wants to see one with her own eyes, as it would be a huge scoop.{{Cite|I just wanted to see this creepy {{Color BotW|Red|Stalhorse monster}} once with my own eyes! If it really does exist, it'd be such a big scoop!|Juannelle|BotW}} However, she can no longer continue because of the cold, so she asks Link to get a [[Picture]] of it for her.{{Cite|But... Well, I can handle all kinds of dangers and hazards, but this cold... Brrr, I can't stand it! Can you handle this task for me? I'll even reward you! All I need is a picture! Or some notes!|Juannelle|BotW}} Once Link agrees to help her, Juannelle will tell him about rumors of a Stalhorse being found with [[Stalkoblin]]s in the [[N. Tabantha Snowfield]] or near the [[North Lomei Labyrinth]] to the east.{{Cite|[I can do it.] Good answer! There's a rumor it can be found with {{Color BotW|Blue|Stalkoblins}} in the {{Color BotW|Blue|North Tabantha Snowfield}}. Some have reported it aaaaall the way on the other side of the snow field to the east, right in front of those bizarre {{Color BotW|Blue|ruins}}.|Juannelle|BotW}}{{Cite|The last I'd heard, it supposedly wanders around the {{Color BotW|Blue|North Tabantha Snowfield}} near the weird {{Color BotW|Blue|ruins}} to the east.|Juannelle|BotW}} She wishes Link luck and reiterates that she is counting on him.{{Cite|Good luck! I'm really counting on you!|Juannelle|BotW}} With this, the [[Side Quest]] begins. At night, Link can go to either of these locations, where he can find a Stalhorse to take a Picture of using the [[Camera]] [[Rune]]. When Link shows the Picture to Juannelle, she will be shocked at the sight.{{Cite|[Found it!] Wha—? This is the {{Color BotW|Red|bony horse}}? That {{Color BotW|Blue|Stalhorse}}... It's a monster!|Juannelle|BotW}} Though she believes it will haunt her dreams for weeks, she still thinks the Picture is amazing and all she needs for her article.{{Cite|The sight of this is going to haunt my dreams for weeks... But the picture is still amazing! Yup, that picture's all I need! Oh, thank you! This is a great picture! It'll be the perfect inspiration for the article I'm going to write!|Juannelle|BotW}} As a reward, she gives Link a [[Silver Rupee]].{{Cite|Here's your reward, just as I promised!|Juannelle|BotW}} She hopes to work with him again in the future,{{Cite|I hope we get a chance to work together again in the future!|Juannelle|BotW}} and the Side Quest will be completed. ==Objectives== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Juannelle in the Snowfield Stable wants to see what a {{Color BotW|Red|Stalhorse}} looks like.

What would be the best way to show her?

She's heard that the Stalhorse appears in the eastern part of N. Tabantha Snowfield, in the area surrounding some strange ruins. |- | Complete | When you showed the picture of the Stalhorse to Juannelle, she carefully traced it so she'd have her own copy.

It seems she plans on using the picture in an article she's writing. With the picture for inspiration, she's excited to get to work! }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Juannelle * Snowfield Stable }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
